text: One can also (sort of) visualize the momentum flow, where we use powers to denote the dots

FCLoopIntegralToGraph[FCTopology[topo1X1, {SFAD[{{p2, 0}, {m1^2, 1}, 2}], SFAD[{{p1, 0}, {m1^2, 1}, 2}], SFAD[{{p2 + p3, 0}, {0, 1}, 1}], SFAD[{{p2 + p3, 0}, {0, 1}, 1}], SFAD[{{p1 + p3, 0}, {0, 1}, 1}], SFAD[{{p1 + p2 + p3, 0}, {0, 1}, 1}]}, {p1, p2, p3}, {}, {}, {}]] FCLoopGraphPlot[%, GraphPlot -> {MultiedgeStyle -> 0.35, Frame -> True}, Labeled -> { {"InternalLine", x_, pow_, _} :> x^pow, {"ExternalLine", _} :> {}}]
